text:
I'm sorry your monstera arrived like that. Snapped main stems count as damaged on arrival, but that has to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, and at 3 days you're past that window. Plant issues after 48 hours go through our Plant Care Guarantee instead, which runs 30 days from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members).

To start a claim, go to "My Orders" and upload at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up of the break). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. The guarantee's criteria don't explicitly mention a snapped stem, so I can't promise the outcome. If you'd like, I can escalate your case to a Support Lead to look at the timing.
